definitions.accounts.*_close_settled: read on the model after the run: units held, owners, most units on one node, held units marked at the closing price, and total claims.
definitions.accounts.*_initial: read on the model before the run, after the opening allocation: units held in all and by tier, owners, most units on one node, the mean opening claim per node, the supply by tier, the opening price ladder, and the cheapest gate on any node divided by the stretch.
definitions.accounts.asset_layer_inert: true when no unit is held at the opening or at the close and the settled claim history equals the recorded one element for element, so the run is the plain carrier's run.
definitions.accounts.claims_settled: asset carrier only: the same three readings on the claims after the last round's asset step, which collects rent, serves stretch debt, settles resales and reprices.
definitions.accounts.last_round_cash_moved, last_rou: whether any node's claims differ between claims_recorded and claims_settled, and the largest single-node difference.
definitions.accounts.net_worth: asset carrier only: the same three readings on net_worth(), settled claims plus held units at the closing price.
definitions.asset_accounts: the stage's readings on the asset grid under each account, the null arm's holdings by size, the last asset step, how net worth compares with claims, and the share of net worth held as units. Printed, not scored.
definitions.direction_by_fraction: A14-3's comparison of the two degree arms, made for all six of its quantities at each core share on claims_recorded: the path of the five-seed mean over the sizes, how many seeds are higher at the largest size than at the smallest, and how many of the pairs of one run at each of those two sizes are. Printed, not scored; A14-3 itself is registered at 0.10.
definitions.per_node_control: the same 27 cells and seeds with the asset layer held per node: AssetSpec(units_per_node=0.5) and the opening price ladder times 200 / n, the network configuration untouched. At 200 nodes this is the asset grid's own specification. Printed, not scored.
definitions.top1_wealth, top01_wealth, gini: claims_recorded: shares and Gini of the last history row (NetworkHistory.holdings[-1]), written after the last round's network step and before its asset step. On the registered carrier nothing follows that row and claims are the whole of what a node holds.
